---
title: "CLI reference"
---

| Command | Effect |
|---|---|
| `preview <file.qmd> [port]` | Live preview server (default port 4321; aliases `dev`, `serve`) |
| `preview <dir>` | Live **multi-page site/book** preview (cross-page nav + per-page hot reload) |
| `build <file.qmd> [out.html]` | Write a self-contained HTML file (default `<name>.html`) |
| `build <file.qmd> --out <dir>` | Write `<dir>/index.html` + copied assets (a portable folder) |
| `build <file.qmd> --bare` | Write a **bare** page: zero `<script>`, zero CDN, CSS-only theme (drafts / archives / print input) |
| `build <dir> [--out <dir>]` | Build a **multi-page site/book** to `_site/` / `_book/` |
| `render <file.qmd>` | Render a one-shot full HTML page to stdout |
| `blocks <file.qmd>` | List block ids and sourcepos (for debugging) |
| `schema [--out <dir>]` | Emit the bundled JSON Schemas for `_site.yml` + front matter (editor autocomplete) |
| `check <file.qmd\|dir> [--format human\|json]` | List every located diagnostic and exit non-zero if any (a CI / pre-publish gate) |
| `init [dir]` | Scaffold a minimal previewable site (`_site.yml` + `index.qmd`) in `dir` (default `.`); refuses to overwrite |

`check` renders the document or site in memory and reports everything that flows
through the diagnostics channel: unknown front-matter / `_site.yml` / cell-option /
container keys (with did-you-mean), unknown callout kinds, broken `@xref`
cross-references, unknown shortcodes, a missing `bibliography:`, duplicate heading
`{#id}`s, broken in-page `#anchor` links, and opt-in `prose-lint:` findings. It also
catches these **publish-blocking** mistakes:

| Rule | Flags |
|---|---|
| Broken relative link | A `[text](other.qmd)` / `[text](page.html#x)` whose **local target file** is missing. In a site, links resolve against the page registry (`.qmd`→`.html`), so a cross-page anchor `page.html#frag` whose `frag` is no id on that page is flagged too. **External `http(s)://` links are never checked** — `check` stays offline and deterministic, and a `{{< embed >}}` deck or a cross-book / mounted link (one that climbs above the site root) is left alone. |
| Missing local video | A `{{< video clip.mp4 >}}` (or a raw `<video src>` / `<video><source></video>`) whose local file is absent — the video sibling of the local-image check. `<audio>` sources are skipped (often streamed/generated). |
| Dangling reactive input | A `{js}` cell's `//\| input: x` that no `{js}` cell (`//\| name`/`//\| viewof`) or `{{< input >}}` control defines, with a did-you-mean over the known names. Suppressed when the doc has a Python/R cell (a runtime `ojs_define` may publish the name). |
| Reactive dependency cycle | A loop among `{js}` cells (`a` consumes `b`, `b` consumes `a`), statically mirroring the runtime graph so none would run. |

It does **not** execute code cells (it is fast, kernel-free,
and deterministic, so runtime cell errors stay in `preview`/`build`). Output is
`path:line: message` by default, or a `[{file, line, message}]` array with
`--format json`. It exits `0` when clean and `1` when any diagnostic is found, so it
drops straight into CI or a pre-commit hook:

```sh
qmd-fast check .                          # fails (exit 1) if any page has a diagnostic
qmd-fast check . --format json > problems.json
```

`--version` / `-V` prints the version; `--help` / `-h` (or no arguments) prints usage. If
the default port (or one you pass) is already in use, `preview` auto-picks the next free
port and logs the chosen URL.

`preview` takes these flags (they may appear anywhere on the line):

| Flag | Effect |
|---|---|
| `--host` | Bind your LAN and print a **QR code** for phones, gated by a per-session access token (see below) |
| `--open` | Launch the default browser at the preview URL |
| `--no-exec` | Render code cells as source without executing them (preview untrusted docs safely) |

`build` takes these flags (they may appear anywhere on the line):

| Flag | Effect |
|---|---|
| `--out <dir>` (alias `--dir`) | Write a portable `<dir>/index.html` + copied assets instead of a single file |
| `--strict` | Exit non-zero if any cell errored or any located warning fired (a CI gate; the page is still written) |
| `--bare` | Single-doc only: emit a **bare** page (zero `<script>`, zero CDN, CSS-only theming) |

A regular `build` already content-gates the optional enhancer scripts (mermaid, `{js}`,
walkthrough, tabset, scrolly) to the constructs a page actually uses, so a prose page
ships less JavaScript without losing any feature. `--bare` goes further for a
single document: it ships **no** `<script>` at all and themes purely with CSS (a forced
`theme:` is hard-coded; otherwise it follows the OS via `prefers-color-scheme`).
Server-rendered math still works; `{js}` cells, Mermaid rendering, and the
copy/lightbox/reader controls are dropped (each warned, never silently). A slide deck or
a `<dir>` site is refused (their navigation needs JavaScript). A `build` skips code
execution only through the `QMD_FAST_NO_EXEC=1` environment variable, not a `--no-exec`
flag.

`--host` binds `0.0.0.0`, so it gates non-loopback access behind a token baked into
the printed LAN URL and QR (`?t=…`, then a `qmd_token` cookie); a fresh token is
minted each server start, and loopback (`127.0.0.1`) is exempt. See
[Reading on any screen](../using/preview.qmd) for the full behaviour.

A `qmd-fast` launcher on `PATH` (`~/.local/bin/qmd-fast`) rebuilds the release
binary when the tool's sources change, then runs it, so `qmd-fast preview <file>`
works from anywhere.

## Environment

| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `QMD_FAST_PYTHON` | Python with `ipykernel` for `{python}` cells (default `python3`) |
| `QMD_FAST_R` | R with `IRkernel` for `{r}` cells (default `R`) |
| `QMD_FAST_CELL_TIMEOUT` | Per-cell wall-clock cap in seconds before interrupt (default 120; `0` disables the cap, but a per-output silent-hang backstop still applies) |
| `QMD_FAST_HOST` | Same as `--host` (expose on the LAN) |
| `QMD_FAST_OPEN` | Same as `--open` (launch a browser) |
| `QMD_FAST_NO_EXEC` | Same as `--no-exec` (never execute code cells) |
| `QMD_FAST_NO_CACHE` | Ignore and skip writing the `_freeze/` execution cache |
| `QMD_FAST_NO_CLEAR` | Don't clear the terminal on each render (keep scrollback) |
| `QMD_FAST_MERMAID_URL` | Override the Mermaid library URL (self-host next to your site for a fully offline build; on load failure a visible `[data-mermaid-error]` banner shows the diagram source) |

Without a kernel, cells render as highlighted source and the preview shows a
"kernel unavailable" diagnostic rather than failing.
